name: ARN Smart Content Toolkit
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Content Toolkit is a workflow-first WordPress content duplication and draft-preparation plugin. It helps administrators reuse existing pages and posts, prepare independent editable drafts, transform titles and slugs, replace selected content, manage taxonomy operations, and review results before publication.

Instead of treating duplication as a blind one-click copy, the plugin keeps the workflow controlled and draft-first. Source content remains protected, destination drafts stay independently editable, and publishing remains a deliberate administrator action.

The Free edition also provides a manual Similar Draft workflow for preparing review-based drafts from supported public URLs. It does not autonomously crawl websites, mass scrape content, or publish generated records in the background.

🚀 Core Workflow Features

  • ✅ Duplicate supported WordPress pages and posts
  • ✅ Prepare independent editable drafts
  • ✅ Protect the original source record
  • ✅ Prepare with a completely new title
  • ✅ Generate a draft-oriented slug structure
  • ✅ Find and replace selected words or phrases during duplication
  • ✅ Prepare location, service, product, and campaign variations
  • ✅ Use a manual Similar Draft workflow with supported public URLs
  • ✅ Preview detected content and images before saving
  • ✅ Keep external-source workflows review-first
  • ✅ Handle supported structured builder content
  • ✅ Preserve compatible Elementor data during supported operations
  • ✅ Use quick replace and taxonomy movement tools
  • ✅ Review mini previews and action history
  • ✅ Detect or avoid common slug conflicts
  • ✅ Keep publishing under manual administrator control

🧠 Why ARN Smart Content Toolkit?

ARN Smart Content Toolkit is designed for editors and site administrators who want to reuse proven content without editing the live source or rebuilding a draft from the beginning.

It is useful for:

  • 📄 landing-page variations
  • 🛠️ service-page preparation
  • 📍 location-based drafts
  • 🛍️ campaign and product-content preparation
  • 🗂️ structured editorial workflows
  • 🔁 controlled wording changes
  • 🧩 builder-aware draft handling
  • ✍️ review-before-publish processes

The plugin emphasizes preparation, visibility, and manual review instead of uncontrolled publishing automation.

✏️ Prepare With New Title

Prepare With New Title creates an independent draft while allowing the destination to begin with a different title and slug direction.

This is useful when the source structure works but the new draft represents another service, product, location, audience, or campaign. The source remains unchanged, and the new record can be reviewed and edited independently.

Recommended workflow:

  1. Select the supported source page or post.
  2. Choose Prepare With New Title.
  3. Enter the intended destination title.
  4. Create the new draft.
  5. Review the title, slug, content, media, and builder structure.
  6. Publish only after manual approval.

🔄 Smart Find and Replace

The replace workflow can change selected words, phrases, locations, product names, or other repeated text while preparing a new draft.

It can support workflows such as:

  • replacing one city with another
  • preparing a related service page
  • changing a campaign or product name
  • updating repeated contact or offer language
  • creating a controlled content variation

Review every result before publication. A replacement can affect visible text, structured content, or meaning in ways that require editorial approval.

🌐 Similar Draft Workflow

The Similar Draft workflow accepts a supported public URL, analyzes retrievable content, presents available structure and images for review, and prepares an editable WordPress draft.

The workflow is intentionally controlled:

  • ⚠️ no automatic publishing
  • ⚠️ no autonomous website crawling
  • ⚠️ no background mass scraping
  • ⚠️ no assumption that retrieved content is ready to publish
  • ✅ manual source review
  • ✅ manual image selection
  • ✅ editable destination draft
  • ✅ administrator-controlled publishing

Only use content and media that you have the legal right and permission to reuse.

🧩 Builder-Aware Handling

Modern WordPress content may include more than editor text. ARN Smart Content Toolkit detects supported structured content and uses draft-oriented handling intended to preserve compatible builder information during supported duplication operations.

After creating a draft:

  1. Open the destination in its normal editor or builder.
  2. Confirm that content and layout data are present.
  3. Review responsive settings and media references.
  4. Save the destination once in the builder when required.
  5. Inspect the front end before publication.

Compatibility depends on the source structure, active plugins, builder version, and stored metadata.

👁️ Preview, History, and Safety

Mini previews and action history help administrators understand what was prepared and which workflow produced it. Draft-first processing keeps the destination separate from the live source, while slug checks reduce common destination conflicts.

Before processing important production content, create a current site and database backup.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN Clonex Pro

ARN Clonex is the professional structured duplication and content-production system for teams that need deeper copy control, builder preservation, datasets, bulk production, previews, validation, and recovery.

Clonex Pro expands the Free workflow with capabilities such as:

  • ⚡ Advanced copy scope — choose supported metadata, custom fields, taxonomies, media, relationships, author, status, destination, and transformation behavior.
  • ⚡ Builder and structure preservation — handle supported Elementor structures, Gutenberg blocks, nested data, responsive settings, styles, widgets, and media relationships.
  • ⚡ Custom fields and taxonomy control — preserve or replace supported ACF fields, compatible custom fields, categories, tags, and custom-taxonomy relationships.
  • ⚡ Structured datasets and placeholders — connect reusable data rows to titles, content, metadata, slugs, fields, taxonomies, and supported builder locations.
  • ⚡ Matrix and variation production — calculate and generate controlled content combinations as independent drafts.
  • ⚡ WooCommerce and custom content — duplicate supported products, product media, attributes, metadata, custom post types, and related structures.
  • ⚡ Bulk operations and queues — process large workloads through controlled batches with pending, active, completed, skipped, and failed states.
  • ⚡ Preview and validation — review source scope, dataset values, placeholders, planned output, conflicts, required fields, and structural integrity.
  • ⚡ Failure isolation and recovery — preserve successful output and retry only affected jobs.
  • ⚡ Multisite-aware governance — keep supported site contexts, queues, histories, permissions, and configuration separated appropriately.
  • ⚡ Licensed updates and priority support — connect the installation to ARN Smart for professional update delivery and assistance.

Learn more: Explore ARN Clonex

🆓 Free vs ARN Clonex Pro

The Free edition focuses on everyday draft preparation:

  • ✅ supported page and post duplication
  • ✅ independent editable drafts
  • ✅ source-record protection
  • ✅ new-title and slug preparation
  • ✅ find-and-replace workflows
  • ✅ manual Similar Draft preparation
  • ✅ mini previews and action history
  • ✅ supported builder-aware handling
  • ✅ manual review and publishing control

Clonex Pro is designed for production workflows requiring:

  • ⭐ detailed include and exclude scopes
  • ⭐ advanced builder and relationship preservation
  • ⭐ metadata, ACF, custom fields, and custom taxonomies
  • ⭐ datasets, placeholders, matrices, and planned outputs
  • ⭐ WooCommerce and supported custom post types
  • ⭐ bulk queues, scheduled or multistage workflows
  • ⭐ previews, dry runs, validation, diagnostics, and recovery
  • ⭐ licensed updates and professional support

🔗 Other ARN Smart Products

  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer / ARN WebPix — local image optimization in Free; advanced discovery, coverage, queues, delivery, and diagnostics in Pro.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager / ARN Linkix — short links, redirects, QR codes, and local analytics in Free; URL intelligence, campaigns, advanced QR, and reporting in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent / ARN Smart Visioix — visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics, and contact actions in Free; connected visitor and website intelligence in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Elementor Site Utilities / ARN Smart Vendix — essential Elementor widgets and site utilities in Free; advanced widgets, design systems, protection, and website operations in Pro.

Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External Services

The Free edition does not require an ARN Smart account or license service. The Similar Draft workflow connects to a public URL only when an authorized user explicitly enters that URL and starts the retrieval action. Retrieved content must be reviewed and used only when the site owner has appropriate rights.

Links in this readme open ARN Smart product pages only when selected by the user.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate ARN Smart Content Toolkit.
  3. Open ARN Clonex from the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Select the required draft, title, replace, taxonomy, or Similar Draft workflow.
  5. Review the preview and destination settings.
  6. Create the draft and inspect it before publishing.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically publish generated drafts?

No. Prepared records require manual review and publishing by an authorized administrator or editor.

Does the plugin change my live source content?

No. The workflow creates an independent destination draft and keeps the source record protected.

Can I change the title while duplicating?

Yes. Prepare With New Title lets the destination begin with a different title and draft slug direction.

Can I replace repeated words during duplication?

Yes. Use the controlled find-and-replace workflow, then review the complete destination before publication.

Does Similar Draft copy and publish external websites automatically?

No. It is a manual, review-based draft workflow. It does not autonomously crawl sites, mass scrape content, or publish in the background.

Does the plugin support builder content?

It includes supported builder-aware handling. Compatibility depends on the stored source structure, editor, builder version, and active integrations. Always inspect the destination.

Is the destination permanently linked to the source?

No. The destination is an independently editable WordPress record.

What does ARN Clonex Pro add?

Clonex adds advanced copy scope, builder structures, custom fields, taxonomies, datasets, placeholders, matrix generation, products, custom content, bulk queues, previews, validation, recovery, licensed updates, and priority support.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added Prepare With Toolkit to the intended quick-action workflow.
  • Improved exact Elementor duplication and preservation of compatible escaped builder metadata.
  • Deferred automatic draft slugs until the edited title is saved.
  • Made quick-copy actions open the new destination draft directly.

1.0.1

  • Improved the new-title, replace, and structured content workflows.
  • Updated compatibility and general stability.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release with draft preparation, duplication, replacement, Similar Draft, taxonomy, preview, history, and builder-aware workflows.
